# RTG_DISCRETE_GENESIS_DSN_v2.13

**Title:** RTG Discrete Relational Genesis — Canonical Study Ledger
**Date:** 13 November 2026
**Scope:** Fully discrete pre-metric relational universe on $\mathbb{Z}_N$. Interaction from relational distinguishability; no continuous coordinates; no imported continuous coefficients.
**Document class:** Technical scientific ledger (Methodology v1.4 §0.5): standard §0–§9 with Appendices A and B and the scientific Appendix C (TDR-T requirements).
**Document status:** DRAFT — stage-2 candidate of v2.13; not adopted. `tdrg-v2.12.15` governs until the PI adopts and tags this edition.
**Supersedes:** `RTG_DISCRETE_GENESIS_DSN` v2.12.15 (tag `tdrg-v2.12.15`, SHA-256 `1e35be54a37bb227cd75e34fc1cd6732ae95782bdc147a76e736f16760c92e64`)
**Companion documents:** Programme Overview v1.4 (`programme-v1.4`) · Ontological Foundations v0.12 (`ofn-v0.12`) · DSN Methodology v1.4 (`methodology-v1.4`)
**DSN Methodology:** DSN_METHODOLOGY_v1.4 (`methodology-v1.4`)
**Status summary:** TDR-G is a finite-state relational universe on $\mathbb{Z}_N$ with three characterized multistar-policy branches: $k/N$ controls entry into the growth regime, and the multistar interaction axiom controls its character. On the canonical clean branch (`bound_symmetric`) the bulk-conditioned birth rate falls as $B_{\rm bulk}/\text{step}\sim N^{-0.869}$ over $N=120$–$1440$ (a window-dependent full-range fit; crystallization as $N\to\infty$ is `[HEUR]`); TDR-24D and TDR-24F are closed at the mechanism level with their analytic constants OPEN, and the gate before discrete triadic dynamics is TDR-24A → TDR-24B → TDR-24C. The genesis-layer kinematics are exact — two-node lemmas, the three-node BIND3 certification, $n$-node birth-free spectrum conservation and the token laws (§6.5, §6.12, §6.13) — while TDR-6 is PARTIAL and the path orientation rule is relabelling-covariant on the canonical branch (SG-14).
**Programme tier:** Tier 4 — Discrete Programme (see Programme Overview §6)

## Appendix A — Version History {#appendix-a}

One compact entry per edition. Entries before v2.12.14 are shortened to one line; their full text is in Appendix A of the tagged edition `tdrg-v2.12.15` (byte-complete), and the editions from v2.12.13 on are tagged. Retired and corrected statements are in Appendix B.

### v2.13 — November 2026 — maintenance edition
- **Header, Local Tag Aliases, §1 [governance]:** migration to Methodology v1.4. The header is current-only, with the immediate predecessor and a three-sentence status summary. §1 is reduced to readouts with pointers (PI decision D1 (a)). In those readouts the band form of reachability carries the owner grade `[ALG]` of §6.5, the policy branches the grades of §6.6, and BIND3 the grades of §6.12. This aligns the typing of the summary; no grade in §6 changes.
- **§§2–8 [editorial]:** version labels, and correction labels that only gave provenance, are removed from the live sections. Each correction stays recorded in the entries below and in its release record. Under D2 (a) the §2 record is kept in place.
- **§2 TDR-25, Appendix B [scope/typing]:** the superseded failed-relock hypothesis (v2.8) leaves §2; Appendix B records it with its original statement.
- **§6.2, §6.3, §6.5, §7 [evidence]:** the AZ citation is repinned to `az-v0.8` (the entry is byte-identical at `az-v0.6`, `az-v0.7` and `az-v0.8`). The OPEN-OFN-2 connection, the CONV-TICK and LEM-NOANNIHIL consumer pins and the consumer rows are stated at their current editions (OFN v0.12, AZ v0.8). XFER-O08-01 is stated as open, a separate decision of both owners.
- **§2 [governance]:** the owner-review tasks are stated as TDR-G's own current items.
- **§8, Appendix A, footer [editorial]:** §A.sim is moved verbatim to §8 (D3 (a)). Appendix A is compacted; the footer has one line.
- **Not changed:** every scientific result, RID, grade, OPEN state, scope guard and evidence state. Plan `records/tdrg/TDRG_v2_13_EDIT_PLAN.md`; release record `records/tdrg/TDRG_v2_13_RELEASE_RECORD.md`; predecessor `tdrg-v2.12.15`.

### v2.12.15 — 12 November 2026 — adopted
- **§6.3 [scientific]:** TDRG-DEF-STAR states the implemented event domain: every component with exactly one valid centre, any shape (owner finding N4). TDRG-DEF-MULTISTAR and CONV-TICK step 4 are aligned.
- **§6.13 [scientific]:** token laws TDRG-ALG-EVENT-INVENTORY, TDRG-ALG-NARROW-BAND-CLASSES, TDRG-ALG-TOKEN-CENSUS-LAW, TDRG-ALG-BIRTH-SPECTRUM-INJECTION, TDRG-ALG-SPECCONS-N, TDRG-ALG-BIRTH-SPECTRUM-NOT-CLOSED and TDRG-ALG-PARENT-CHILD-PHASE, with the owner check TDRG-NUM-TOKEN-LAW-CHECK. They were proposed by AZ and are credited to AZ. The LEM-SPECCONS $n$-node conjecture is resolved.
- **§2, §3, Appendix B [scope/typing]:** TDR-6 is PARTIAL; the signed-class set is invariant, with its relational status undecided. $P$ is not conserved at births and is not a gauge quantity (SG-3, OFN finding). SG-12 and OPEN-SPECCONS-STAR are updated.

- Release record `records/tdrg/TDRG_v2_12_15_RELEASE_RECORD.md`; predecessor `tdrg-v2.12.14`.
